name: John Sohrawardi
bio: John Sohrawardi is a PhD student in the Golisano College of Computing and Information Sciences at the Rochester Institute of Technology. His research interests include human-computer interaction, accessibility, and assistive technology. He is a member of the Accessible Computing Lab at RIT, where he works on projects related to accessibility and usability. He is also a member of the RIT Center for Accessibility and Inclusion Research, where he works on projects related to accessibility and inclusion in higher education. He is a recipient of the NSF Graduate Research Fellowship and the RIT Provost's Scholarship.
